description: This file defines the TagRepository interface in a Java Spring Data JPA project for managing tags within a book-tracking application. It extends JpaRepository and includes custom query and entity graph methods for fetching Tag entities.

classes.name: TagRepository
classes.description: A Spring Data JPA repository interface for performing CRUD and custom operations on Tag entities.

methods.name: findByName
methods.description: Finds a Tag entity by its name (case-insensitive). Returns an Optional<Tag>.

methods.name: findById
methods.description: Finds a Tag entity by its ID, with associated books eagerly fetched using an entity graph.

methods.name: findAll
methods.description: Retrieves all Tag entities, with their associated books eagerly fetched using an entity graph.
